title: Salma and the Two Jars
youtube_title: Salma and the Two Jars | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity looks closely, tells the truth, and lets living things answer in their own time.
summary: Salma wonders why one seed jar is taller. She and Kwame see that books had shaded the shorter jar. They move the shade, leave a seed coat alone, and write an honest log.
